verses.textZh: 我这作长老的写信给亲爱的该犹，就是我在真理中所爱的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我这作长老的写信给亲爱的该犹，就是我在真理中所爱的。
verses.textZhCuv: 作长老的写信给亲爱的该犹，就是我诚心所爱的。
verses.textEnNiv: The elder, To my dear friend Gaius, whom I love in the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: The elder to the beloved Gaius, whom I love in truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Elder, To the beloved Gaius, whom I love in truth:
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from John, the elder. I am writing to Gaius, my dear friend, whom I love in the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: The elder to the beloved Gaius, whom I love in truth.
verses.textEn: The elder, To my dear friend Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

verses.textZh: 亲爱的，我祝你凡事亨通，身体健壮，正如你的灵魂安泰一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲爱的，我祝你凡事亨通，身体健壮，正如你的灵魂安泰一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的兄弟啊，我愿你凡事兴盛，身体健壮，正如你的灵魂兴盛一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well.
verses.textEnEsv: Beloved, I pray that all may go well with you and that you may be in good health, as it goes well with your soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be in health, just as your soul prospers.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear friend, I hope all is well with you and that you are as healthy in body as you are strong in spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: Beloved, I pray that in all respects you may prosper and be in good health, just as your soul prospers.
verses.textEn: Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well.

verses.textZh: 有些弟兄来到，证实你心中存有真理，就是你按真理行事，我就非常欣慰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些弟兄来到，证实你心中存有真理，就是你按真理行事，我就非常欣慰。
verses.textZhCuv: 有弟兄来证明你心里存的真理，正如你按真理而行，我就甚喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: It gave me great joy when some believers came and testified about your faithfulness to the truth, telling how you continue to walk in it.
verses.textEnEsv: For I rejoiced greatly when the brothers came and testified to your truth, as indeed you are walking in the truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I rejoiced greatly when brethren came and testified of the truth thatis in you, just as you walk in the truth.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of the traveling teachers recently returned and made me very happy by telling me about your faithfulness and that you are living according to the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: For I was overjoyed when brothers came and testified to your truth, that is, how you are walking in truth.
verses.textEn: It gave me great joy when some believers came and testified about your faithfulness to the truth, telling how you continue to walk in it.

verses.textZh: 我听见我的儿女按真理行事，我的喜乐没有比这更大的了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见我的儿女按真理行事，我的喜乐没有比这更大的了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见我的儿女们按真理而行，我的喜乐就没有比这个大的。
verses.textEnNiv: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
verses.textEnNlt: I could have no greater joy than to hear that my children are following the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: I have no greater joy than this, to hear of my children walking in the truth.
verses.textEn: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.

verses.textZh: 亲爱的，你向弟兄所行的，特别是向外地来的弟兄所行的，都是出于忠心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲爱的，你向弟兄所行的，特别是向外地来的弟兄所行的，都是出于忠心。
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的兄弟啊，凡你向作客旅之弟兄所行的都是忠心的。
verses.textEnNiv: Dear friend, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers and sisters, even though they are strangers to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Beloved, it is a faithful thing you do in all your efforts for these brothers, strangers as they are,
verses.textEnNkjv: Beloved, you do faithfully whatever you do for the brethren and for strangers,
verses.textEnNlt: Dear friend, you are being faithful to God when you care for the traveling teachers who pass through, even though they are strangers to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Beloved, you are acting faithfully in whatever you accomplish for the brothers and sisters, and especially when they are strangers;
verses.textEn: Dear friend, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers and sisters, even though they are strangers to you.

verses.textZh: 他们在教会面前证实了你的爱；你照着神所喜悦的，资助他们的旅程，这样是好的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在教会面前证实了你的爱；你照着神所喜悦的，资助他们的旅程，这样是好的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在教会面前证明了你的爱；你若配得过神，帮助他们往前行，这就好了。
verses.textEnNiv: They have told the church about your love. Please send them on their way in a manner that honors God.
verses.textEnEsv: who testified to your love before the church. You will do well to send them on their journey in a manner worthy of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: who have borne witness of your love before the church. If you send them forward on their journey in a manner worthy of God, you will do well,
verses.textEnNlt: They have told the church here of your loving friendship. Please continue providing for such teachers in a manner that pleases God.
verses.textEnNasb: and they have testified to your love before the church. You will do well to send them on their way in a manner worthy of God.
verses.textEn: They have told the church about your love. Please send them on their way in a manner that honors God.

verses.textZh: 因为他们为主的名出外，并没有从教外人接受甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们为主的名出外，并没有从教外人接受甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他们是为主的名 出外，对于外邦人一无所取。
verses.textEnNiv: It was for the sake of the Name that they went out, receiving no help from the pagans.
verses.textEnEsv: For they have gone out for the sake of the name, accepting nothing from the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNkjv: because they went forth for His name’s sake, taking nothing from the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNlt: For they are traveling for the Lord, and they accept nothing from people who are not believers.
verses.textEnNasb: For they went out for the sake of the Name, accepting nothing from the Gentiles.
verses.textEn: It was for the sake of the Name that they went out, receiving no help from the pagans.

verses.textZh: 所以我们应当接待这样的人，好让我们为了真理成为同工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我们应当接待这样的人，好让我们为了真理成为同工。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我们应该接待这样的人，叫我们与他们一同为真理做工。
verses.textEnNiv: We ought therefore to show hospitality to such people so that we may work together for the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore we ought to support people like these, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may become fellow workers for the truth.
verses.textEnNlt: So we ourselves should support them so that we can be their partners as they teach the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore we ought to support such people, so that we may prove to be fellow workers with the truth.
verses.textEn: We ought therefore to show hospitality to such people so that we may work together for the truth.

verses.textZh: 我曾经略略写信给你那里的教会，但他们中间那好作领袖的丢特腓不接待我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾经略略写信给你那里的教会，但他们中间那好作领袖的丢特腓不接待我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我曾略略地写信给教会，但那在教会中好为首的丢特腓不接待我们。
verses.textEnNiv: I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will not welcome us.
verses.textEnEsv: I have written something to the church, but Diotrephes, who likes to put himself first, does not acknowledge our authority.
verses.textEnNkjv: I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to have the preeminence among them, does not receive us.
verses.textEnNlt: I wrote to the church about this, but Diotrephes, who loves to be the leader, refuses to have anything to do with us.
verses.textEnNasb: I wrote something to the church; but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, does not accept what we say.
verses.textEn: I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will not welcome us.

verses.textZh: 因此，我来的时候，必要提起他所作的事，就是他用恶言中伤我们；这还不够，他不但不接待弟兄，还要阻止那些想要接待的人，甚至把他们赶出教会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我来的时候，必要提起他所作的事，就是他用恶言中伤我们；这还不够，他不但不接待弟兄，还要阻止那些想要接待的人，甚至把他们赶出教会。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我若去，必要提说他所行的事，就是他用恶言妄论我们。还不以此为足，他自己不接待弟兄，有人愿意接待，他也禁止，并且将接待弟兄的人赶出教会。
verses.textEnNiv: So when I come, I will call attention to what he is doing, spreading malicious nonsense about us. Not satisfied with that, he even refuses to welcome other believers. He also stops those who want to do so and puts them out of the church.
verses.textEnEsv: So if I come, I will bring up what he is doing, talking wicked nonsense against us. And not content with that, he refuses to welcome the brothers, and also stops those who want to and puts them out of the church.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, if I come, I will call to mind his deeds which he does, prating against us with malicious words. And not content with that, he himself does not receive the brethren, and forbids those who wish to, putting them out of the church.
verses.textEnNlt: When I come, I will report some of the things he is doing and the evil accusations he is making against us. Not only does he refuse to welcome the traveling teachers, he also tells others not to help them. And when they do help, he puts them out of the church.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with malicious words; and not satisfied with this, he himself does not receive the brothers either, and he forbids those who want to do so and puts them out of the church.
verses.textEn: So when I come, I will call attention to what he is doing, spreading malicious nonsense about us. Not satisfied with that, he even refuses to welcome other believers. He also stops those who want to do so and puts them out of the church.

verses.textZh: 亲爱的，不要效法恶，应该效法善。行善的属于神，作恶的没有见过神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲爱的，不要效法恶，应该效法善。行善的属于神，作恶的没有见过神。
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的兄弟啊，不要效法恶，只要效法善。行善的属乎神；行恶的未曾见过神。
verses.textEnNiv: Dear friend, do not imitate what is evil but what is good. Anyone who does what is good is from God. Anyone who does what is evil has not seen God.
verses.textEnEsv: Beloved, do not imitate evil but imitate good. Whoever does good is from God; whoever does evil has not seen God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. He who does good is of God, but he who does evil has not seen God.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear friend, don’t let this bad example influence you. Follow only what is good. Remember that those who do good prove that they are God’s children, and those who do evil prove that they do not know God.
verses.textEnNasb: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does what is good is of God; the one who does what is evil has not seen God.
verses.textEn: Dear friend, do not imitate what is evil but what is good. Anyone who does what is good is from God. Anyone who does what is evil has not seen God.

verses.textZh: 低米丢行善，有众人为他作证，真理本身也为他作证。我们也为他作证，你知道我们的见证是真的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 低米丢行善，有众人为他作证，真理本身也为他作证。我们也为他作证，你知道我们的见证是真的。
verses.textZhCuv: 低米丢行善，有众人给他作见证，又有真理给他作见证，就是我们也给他作见证。你也知道我们的见证是真的。
verses.textEnNiv: Demetrius is well spoken of by everyone—and even by the truth itself. We also speak well of him, and you know that our testimony is true.
verses.textEnEsv: Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself. We also add our testimony, and you know that our testimony is true.
verses.textEnNkjv: Demetrius has a good testimony from all, and from the truth itself. And we also bear witness, and you know that our testimony is true.
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone speaks highly of Demetrius, as does the truth itself. We ourselves can say the same for him, and you know we speak the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself; and we testify too, and you know that our testimony is true.
verses.textEn: Demetrius is well spoken of by everyone—and even by the truth itself. We also speak well of him, and you know that our testimony is true.

verses.textZh: 我还有许多话要写给你，可是我不愿借用笔墨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我还有许多话要写给你，可是我不愿借用笔墨。
verses.textZhCuv: 我原有许多事要写给你，却不愿意用笔墨写给你，
verses.textEnNiv: I have much to write you, but I do not want to do so with pen and ink.
verses.textEnEsv: I had much to write to you, but I would rather not write with pen and ink.
verses.textEnNkjv: I had many things to write, but I do not wish to write to you with pen and ink;
verses.textEnNlt: I have much more to say to you, but I don’t want to write it with pen and ink.
verses.textEnNasb: I had many things to write to you, but I do not want to write to you with pen and ink;
verses.textEn: I have much to write you, but I do not want to do so with pen and ink.

verses.textZh: 我盼望很快就见到你，当面谈谈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我盼望很快就见到你，当面谈谈。
verses.textZhCuv: 但盼望快快地见你，我们就当面谈论。
verses.textEnNiv: I hope to see you soon, and we will talk face to face.
verses.textEnEsv: I hope to see you soon, and we will talk face to face.
verses.textEnNkjv: but I hope to see you shortly, and we shall speak face to face. Peace to you. Our friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.
verses.textEnNlt: For I hope to see you soon, and then we will talk face to face.
verses.textEnNasb: but I hope to see you shortly, and we will speak face to face.
verses.textEn: I hope to see you soon, and we will talk face to face.

verses.textZh: 愿你平安。这里的朋友都问候你。请你一一提名问候你那里的朋友。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你平安。这里的朋友都问候你。请你一一提名问候你那里的朋友。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你平安。众位朋友都问你安。请你替我按着姓名问众位朋友安。
verses.textEnNiv: Peace to you. The friends here send their greetings. Greet the friends there by name.
verses.textEnEsv: Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends, each by name.
verses.textEnNkjv: Peace to you. The friends here send their greetings. Greet the friends there by name.
verses.textEnNlt: Peace be with you. Your friends here send you their greetings. Please give my personal greetings to each of our friends there.
verses.textEnNasb: Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.
verses.textEn: Peace to you. The friends here send their greetings. Greet the friends there by name.
